name: tilttek/badges-bundle
description: Badges for Symfony on tilttek/badges: badges and criteria in configuration, awards and consents in Doctrine DBAL, the projection that awards them through tilttek/activity-bundle, events, Twig showcase and progress, commands, Open Badges 3.0 credentials through phil/open-badges-bundle, and member export and erasure

suggest.doctrine/orm: To add the badges' tables to the schema the ORM generates, and so to the migrations
suggest.phil/open-badges-bundle: To issue a member's badges as Open Badges 3.0 credentials, secured by the application's issuer
suggest.phil/privacy-bundle: To export and erase a member's badges with the rest of their account
suggest.symfony/console: For the commands that award, withdraw and list a member's badges
suggest.symfony/translation: To translate the badges' names and descriptions in the credentials
suggest.symfony/twig-bundle: For the Twig functions and the templates of the showcase and the progress
suggest.symfony/uid: For the Open Badges credentials of a member's badges
suggest.tilttek/activity-bundle: To keep the journal of activity the criteria read, and catch the badges projection up live or by a command
